CustomField.description: When this item was completed. DATETIME, AND NAMED FOR IT. The requirement says completed-date, but the value it replaces is Task.LastModifiedDate, a Datetime, and the wire verification modal renders a time - so a Date would lose information the control depends on. The naming convention forbids suffixing a DateTime field with Date, which is exactly the trap this field name avoids.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date and time this item was completed. Set automatically; do not edit.
CustomField.label: Completed DateTime
